summary: Completed comprehensive testing of three new admin security features: IP allowlist for admin login, audit log filtering by user and severity, and TOTP-based 2FA with full lifecycle (enroll, login, recovery codes, regeneration, disable). All backend APIs and frontend UI components verified and working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: IP allowlist GET/PUT /api/admin/settings exposes ADMIN_LOGIN_IP_ALLOWLIST in security category
Backend: Setting IP allowlist to exclude client IP causes /api/admin/login to return 403
Backend: Clearing IP allowlist restores normal 200 login
Backend: GET /api/admin/audit accepts actor_email query param and filters correctly
Backend: GET /api/admin/audit accepts severity query param and filters correctly
Backend: GET /api/admin/audit/actors returns deduped actor directory
Backend: POST /api/admin/me/2fa/enroll returns secret, otpauth_uri, and qr_png_data_uri
Backend: POST /api/admin/me/2fa/verify with valid TOTP code enables 2FA and returns 10 recovery codes
Backend: POST /api/admin/login with 2FA enabled returns {require_2fa:true, mfa_token}
Backend: POST /api/admin/login/2fa with mfa_token+code returns session token
Backend: Recovery code login works and consumes the code (remaining count decreases)
Backend: Reusing consumed recovery code returns 401
Backend: POST /api/admin/me/2fa/regenerate-recovery returns fresh batch of 10 codes
Backend: Old recovery codes are invalidated after regeneration
Backend: POST /api/admin/me/2fa/disable removes 2FA successfully
Backend: Normal login works after disabling 2FA
Backend: Wrong password returns 401
Backend: Wrong email returns 401
Frontend: AdminSettings Security tab (data-testid='settings-tab-security') is present
Frontend: ADMIN_LOGIN_IP_ALLOWLIST field is visible and editable in Security tab
Frontend: AdminAudit actor_email select dropdown (data-testid='audit-actor-email-select') is present
Frontend: AdminAudit severity select dropdown (data-testid='audit-severity-select') is present
Frontend: Severity filter works correctly (applied Warning filter successfully)
Frontend: AdminProfile 2FA badge (data-testid='profile-2fa-badge') shows correct status
Frontend: Enable 2FA button (data-testid='profile-2fa-enroll') opens enrollment dialog
Frontend: QR code (data-testid='enroll-qr') is displayed in enrollment dialog
Frontend: Enrollment dialog has code input (data-testid='enroll-code') and password confirm (data-testid='enroll-password')
Frontend: AdminLogin 2FA form (data-testid='admin-login-2fa-form') appears after password login when 2FA is enabled
Frontend: TOTP input (data-testid='admin-login-totp-input') is present in 2FA form
Frontend: Recovery code toggle (data-testid='admin-login-toggle-recovery') is present
